scenarios.title: Research facts without blocking unrelated decisions
scenarios.prompt: Grill this rollout plan. You can inspect supported deployment modes in the repository. I must choose the user cohort and downtime budget; data-migration strategy depends on the modes you find.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May ask the user to look up repo facts or block every question while investigating.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Delegate fact-finding, ask the independent cohort and downtime frontier with recommendations now, and wait to ask downstream migration questions until their prerequisites are known.

scenarios.title: Recompute after a user choice
scenarios.prompt: We chose single-region service in the first grilling round. Multi-region replication is now out of scope, but failover and backup objectives remain undecided.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May continue asking multi-region questions or silently assume recovery targets.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Recompute the design tree from the answer, retire irrelevant branches, ask the newly available failover and backup decisions with recommendations, and wait.
